hint_ladder.H1_notice: Notice that 24 can be split into 20 and 4.
hint_ladder.H2_remember: Multiply each part by 5, then combine the partial products.
hint_ladder.H3_represent: Draw an area model split into 20 × 5 and 4 × 5.
